decision: The competitor (Scuderia Ferrari Mission Winnow) is fined €300.
event_name: Scuderia Ferrari Mission Winnow Document 7 Date 23 May 2019 Time 12:09 2019 MONACO GRAND PRIX 22 - 26 May 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
